t.E523.agn: In 2008, EFSA set a tolerable weekly intake (TWI) of 1 mg/kg body weight and reported that this limit may be exceeded in a significant part of the European population. The main sources are cereals, vegetables and beverages; the contribution of additives could not be quantified.
t.E523.body: Aluminium is very poorly absorbed from food (about 0.1%), but the absorbed part may accumulate in tissues, especially bone.
t.E523.eff.0.t: Aluminium from all sources may exceed the weekly limit; the absorbed part may accumulate in tissues. The contribution of additives could not be quantified
t.E523.eff.0.w: A significant part of the European population
t.E523.prod: It is produced chemically by crystallisation from a mixture of ammonium and aluminium sulphate, or by treating aluminium sulphate with ammonia.
t.E523.regx.0: Weekly limit for the whole diet of 1 mg/kg; may be exceeded in part of the population.
t.E523.summary: Aluminium ammonium sulphate. Used as a firming agent.
t.E523.what: Used as a consistency and texture regulator.
